text: The 2025 tree-cover loss of **13.5 ha (3.91% of the asset)** is confirmed but **not persistent**. The **Hansen GFC 2025** dataset detected the loss, but no later-year data exists to confirm its permanence. The **JRC 2020 reference** (98% forest overlap in 2020) supports the event area, while **MGAP 2021** confirms the loss occurred in native forest (13.1 ha). However, without post-2025 observations, we cannot determine if the loss was temporary (e.g., disturbance or fire) or permanent (e.g., land conversion). The loss meets the **50% corroboration rule** but lacks persistence validation.
